purpose: Rights register for the clean-room AIAssistent1 assistant SFT V14 dataset and its sealed V14 holdout.

review.decision_evidence: Direct rights-holder authorization in the Codex task on 2026-09-06 confirms that V14 and its holdout belong to the project, contain no real personal data, and are permitted for model training and derivative-weight distribution. The authorization approves the five-intent contract, a 300-row manual train layer, a 90-row manual validation layer, a 60-row sealed holdout, calendar_sum, and the implementation plan. Earlier retained sources remain covered by the VERIFIED V13 register. The dataset generator was not run. prepare_dataset.py excluded generated candidates and every historical row with a removed mutation intent before producing the exact V14 artifacts.

records.rights_evidence: All retained earlier sources are covered by the VERIFIED V13 rights register; V14 staging removes disallowed rows without adding external data.
Direct rights-holder authorization on 2026-09-06 covers the 300 manually authored V14 training examples.
Direct rights-holder authorization on 2026-09-06 covers the 90 manually authored V14 validation examples.
Direct rights-holder authorization on 2026-09-06 covers the 60 manually authored sealed V14 holdout examples.
